input: Find general day camps, church day camps, Parks & Recreation camps and summer childcare summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Sylva, Dillsboro, Cullowhee, Cashiers, Cherokee and Bryson City, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Sylva Cullowhee Jackson County summer camp 2026 recreation kids

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: First Explorers summer day camp ran in June 2026, with field trips and hands-on activities.

candidates.name: Cullowhee United Methodist Church
candidates.note: Whee Read offered a five-week summer literacy program for rising grades 1–3, June 8–July 10, 2026.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Programs include Lil’ Cats recreation camp, themed educational day camps, athletics camps and overnight youth programs.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of the Plateau
candidates.note: 2026 summer camp served rising grades 1–12 at the Cashiers Club and Abell Teen Club; Highlands location excluded.

candidates.name: Swain County Recreation Department
candidates.note: County recreation summer day camp; a summer camp counselor position was posted in 2026.

candidates.name: Cherokee Youth Center / Boys & Girls Clubs of Cherokee
candidates.note: Youth and teen summer programming; the organization published a 2025 parent handbook and offers summer-only activity clubs.

candidates.name: First Presbyterian Church of Sylva
candidates.note: Church calendar lists a morning VBS program on May 26, 2026.

candidates.name: Locust Field Baptist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: Illumination Station VBS began July 12, 2026, with an evening start time.

candidates.name: Piney Mountain Baptist Church of Whittier
candidates.note: Evening VBS was listed for June 10, 2026, near Dillsboro at 344 Piney Mountain Road.

candidates.name: Silvermine Missionary Baptist Church of Bryson City
candidates.note: Wonder VBS ran June 21–26, 2026, at 2370 Silvermine Road.

candidates.name: Cashiers Baptist Church
candidates.note: Rainforest Falls VBS was listed for June 21–25, 2026, beginning at 5:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Southwestern Community College
candidates.note: Summer 2025 youth programs included entrepreneurship camp for rising grades 6–9 at the Jackson Campus.

candidates.name: Cashiers-Highlands Humane Society
candidates.note: Critter Camp offered weeklong summer day sessions in 2026, including June 22–26.

candidates.name: Endless River Adventures
candidates.note: EcoSplash two-day outdoor camps offered multiple sessions from May through August 2026.

candidates.name: Need More Outdoors
candidates.note: Nonprofit provides EcoSplash summer camps and outdoor youth programs for ages 6 and up in Swain County.

candidates.name: Camp Living Water
candidates.note: Christian summer camp offers July programs for ages 7–12 and 13–17.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Operates Camp Watia, a general overnight youth camp near Bryson City that ran in summer 2026.
